comment: Single source of truth for the second-brain pre-push sentinel. Targets credentials and gross PII leaks, NOT the vault's normal content (a personal vault legitimately holds financial and medical facts, insurance/policy numbers, account references — those are expected and must not be flagged). Sibling to apiary's assets/sentinel-patterns.json, kept independent because the plugins install independently. Adjust patterns to taste; the hook is fail-open, so a bad pattern degrades to no-scan rather than blocking work.
